transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I came in because I need some help with what's going on at my apartment building. I just know the people living around me are watching my comings and goings. They're slipping notes about me to the front office. I mean, everybody keeps telling me they're just regular notices taped to the doors, but... I know what they're really doing.

Can you tell me more about how you know the people in your building are watching you and talking about you? Have you noticed any specific instances where you felt they were targeting you or acting on some kind of shared information about you?

Well, like I was just saying, it's mostly about those notes and how they act when I leave my place. I'll walk down the hall, and I can just tell they're keeping track of my comings and goings. And then, sure enough, these papers get passed around. 

Everybody keeps telling me, you know, that they're just regular notices taped to the doors—like for maintenance or whatever. But I know what's really happening. I know they're slipping notes about me to the front office. They're watching me, and they're using those papers to report on what I'm doing.
Have you ever had any other experiences where you felt people were plotting against you, or that you were receiving special messages that others couldn't understand?

No, I don't think so. It's just the people in my building. I haven't noticed anything like that anywhere else, and I'm not getting any special messages or anything. Just the notes they pass around about me.
Outside of what’s happening in your building, have you ever felt that people were talking about you or acting on information they shouldn’t have?

No, like I just said, it's really just the people in my building. I don't feel like that anywhere else. When I go to the store or out for a walk, nobody pays any attention to me. It's just my neighbors and those notes.
Do you ever have any other unusual beliefs or suspicions that others don’t seem to share, even when they aren’t related to your neighbors or the notes?

No, I really don't. Like I said, it's just the stuff here at the building. I don't have any other... suspicions or whatever you want to call it. Things are pretty normal otherwise, as far as that goes. It's just the neighbors.
Have you ever believed something to be true that others don’t seem to agree with or understand, even if it wasn’t related to your neighbors or the notes?

No, I don't. I mean, I feel like you keep asking me the same thing in different ways. But no, I don't have any other beliefs like that. It's just the neighbors. Everything else is just... regular life.
Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something strongly that others couldn’t see or understand, even if it wasn’t related to your neighbors or the notes?

Look, I... I really don't know how else to answer this for you. No. I haven't. Like I keep saying, it is strictly just the situation with my neighbors. There isn't anything else I'm believing that other people don't get. It's just that one problem.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that you knew were completely true, but you realized later that they weren’t based on reality or something others could confirm?

Look, I don't mean to be difficult, but I really feel like we're just going around in circles here. No, I haven't realized later that they weren't true, because they *are* true. I came in here because I know the people at my apartment building are watching my comings and goings. They're slipping notes about me to the front office. Everybody keeps telling me they're just regular notices they put on all the doors, but I know what's really going on. That's the only thing. There's nothing else.
Are there any other situations, outside of your neighbors and the notes, where you feel certain about something that others don’t seem to notice or believe?

I... I really don't know how to make it any clearer for you, Doc. No. There are no other situations. Like I just said, it's just the neighbors and the notes. That's the only thing going on. I don't know why you keep asking me the exact same question, but my answer is still no. There's nothing else.

Can you think of any other situations, even outside of your building or unrelated to your neighbors, where you have had a strong belief that something is happening or being directed at you that others don’t seem to notice or agree with?

Doc, I feel like a broken record here. No. I really don't have anything else to tell you. There aren't any other situations at all. I don't know how many different ways I can say no to this exact same question. It's just the stuff at my apartment, and that's it. I don't have anything else like that going on anywhere else.
Can you explain how you know for certain that the notes are about you and not just regular notices, especially since others have told you they are not directed at you?

Look, I know what I see. I see the way they look at me when I walk in or out. They're keeping tabs on me, watching my comings and goings. And those notes... everyone says, "Oh, it's just the water shut-off notice," or "It's just the pest control flyer they put on every door." But I know they're slipping things about me to the office. The flyers are just... they're just a cover for it. I don't care what everyone else says, I know what's really happening.
Even though others have told you that the notes are just regular notices, do you feel absolutely certain that they are not telling the truth or are being deceived themselves?

Yeah, I'm absolutely certain. I know what's going on, even if they don't believe me or are just lying to my face. I came in here because I know the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings. They are slipping notes about me to the office. It doesn't matter that everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices on the doors. I know the truth.
Even though others have told you that the notes are just regular notices, and you haven’t seen direct proof that they are about you, do you still feel completely certain that your belief is true?

Yes, I'm completely certain. Like I said, I came in because I know the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings. They are slipping notes about me to the office. I know what's happening. It doesn't matter that everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices on the doors. I know what they're really doing.
Even though there’s no clear proof and others have told you otherwise, do you still believe with complete certainty that the notes are about you and that your neighbors are watching you on purpose?

Look, I feel like I just keep saying the same thing to you. Yes, I am completely sure. I came in here because I know the people at my apartment are watching my comings and goings. They're slipping notes about me to the office. I really don't care that everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices on the doors. I know what's going on, and I know they're watching me.
